extracted.name: Mayonnaise Cake (Nana's)
extracted.description: My Nana has made this ever since I can remember. Very dense but moist, and buttercream frosting on top. I am not a chocolate cake fan, but this is the only chocolate cake I will eat.
instruction_lines: Mix sugar, mayo and cocoa together.
Mix baking soda and salt in warm water.
Add the water mixture to the vanilla (sugar) mixture.
Now add flour; mix all together and bake for 45 minutes. (I'd check it 5-10 minutes before since every oven is different. A toothpick should come out clean.)
Make buttercream frosting, that's the best kind of frosting for this cake. You don't need a whole lot of it since this cake is so rich and dense unless that's how you like it. Enjoy!
